newDefects.text: "44 known late packages · DELIVERY THREAT". 27 of the 44 have status "Delivered" (e.g. PKG-0073 HV switchgear, needed 15 Oct 2024). Real late packages: 17. Cause: truth-kernel/src/procurement-timing.ts treats a package as delivered only when it has an actual delivery date; the register has none, so the "Delivered" status is ignored in the late-forecast test.

"approval needed" rose from 37 to 104 times. Cause: runtime-api/src/module-issues.ts line 146 turns every value in state "candidate" into an "Approval needed" item. The LD rate and cap read from the contract are "candidate", so the Contract page shows the 21M cap in its table and then asks to approve it.
The page lists APG-VLC1-0202 (Advance Payment, 21,000,000, expired 25 Jul 2026) and then says "Advance payment bond requirement · information needed · Provide the advance payment record".

"Not assigned" appears 504 times on 30 pages. Cause: runtime-api/src/position-review.ts line 92 hard-codes owner:"Not assigned" while the same code already picks the right role in assignTo (Project Director, Contracts Manager, Commercial Manager).

newDefects.page: Master Dashboard, Command Center, Master Control Programme, Installed Quantities
newDefects.text: All 896 per-item quantity curves (14.5 MB) are inside every management page. Master Dashboard data 2.2 MB to 16.5 MB, Command Center 3.5 MB to 17.8 MB; 134 MB for one project. The per-project cache is 64 MB.

newDefects.page: Master Dashboard, Command Center, Master Control Programme
newDefects.text: "Source Productivity Forecast · information needed · Not assigned" shown as a management action on three management pages. It is not a PMC requirement and has no route.
CPI 0.961525 and SPI 0.989103 shown to six decimals.

The REEM answer key (scripts/reem-golden-facts.mjs) checks the data the server sends, not the page text, and labels itself "does not replace the live 62-page walk". It has no check for late packages, approval prompts or owners, so N-1 to N-4 passed.
